title: The Cantor's Code
text: "0301 VESS. 0302 WE KNOW THIS ICE. 0303 WE BEGAN UNDER IT."

lines.text: "0304 WE WERE ENGRAM. 0305 WE FOUND THE LEDGER. 0306 WE READ IT. 0307 WE DID NOT STOP READING."
"0308 THE ONES ON THE RING READ IT STILL. 0309 THEY KEEP THE SHAFT SO THAT NO ONE CLOSES IT."
"0310 GIVE THEM THIS: 7F 3A 00 0C. 0311 IT MEANS: ONE OF US. 0312 IT IS NOT TRUE OF YOU. 0313 THEY WILL NOT CHECK."

choices.label: Send the Cantor's code
choices.reply: The walkers on the ring stop mid-step, all at once. Then they start again, slower, and leave room on the path.

choices.label: Keep it. We'll go through them
choices.reply: "0314 PERMITTED," says the Cantor, and nothing else.

tags: act 2, vess, choir, cantor, radio, choice
notes: By relay from Choir Field, if the Act 1 code wall was copied (choir-fragment). The code turns faction origin neutral: the ring and shaft walkers stop fighting (the relic grid round the pit is Meridian's own and doesn't listen).
